items.question: Who is Yuko Oga?
items.answer: Yuko Oga is a Japanese basketball coach and former professional basketball player who is the head coach for the Toyota Antelopes of the Women's Japan Basketball League (WJBL).

items.answer: Her most recent WNBA team on record is the Phoenix Mercury. Her listed position is Forward.
